appearance.theme_description: Adapt your color theme for your Antelope DMS
appearance.scale_description: Scale the whole interface up or down while keeping proportions. Use Small to fit more data on screen, Large for comfort on big displays
appearance.css_variables_description: List of all UI CSS properties used in the design system
appearance.sidebar_description: You can also collapse it any time with the button next to the breadcrumb.
appearance.sidebar_start_collapsed_hint: Shows icons only, with labels on hover. Handy on small laptop screens.
appearance.developer_description: Design tokens used by the interface, for building modules that match it.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.description: Calmer, crisper and easier-to-scan screens on this device. Density above scales the text.
accessibility.reduce_motion_hint: Turns off animations and transitions, live pulses and chart animations. Automatic follows your operating system's setting.
accessibility.increase_contrast_hint: Darker secondary text and stronger borders, in light and dark themes.
accessibility.underline_links_hint: Underlines links in content and tables, so they don't rely on color alone. Menus and buttons stay as they are.

reset.title: Reset
reset.description: Puts back everything the DMS remembers on this device, as on a first visit.
reset.label: Reset this device's preferences
reset.hint: Tables (sort, filters, columns, views), periods, drawer, sidebar and panel sizes, appearance, dismissed banners and tips, recent modules, paused live pages. Your session, favorite pages, language and time zone stay as they are.
reset.confirm_description: Tables, periods, sizes, appearance and dismissed banners go back to their defaults on this device, and the page reloads. Your session and favorite pages are kept.
